description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is a core component of a logging system in an Android application. It specifies a method for outputting log data, supporting customizable logging chains or filters.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain, capable of outputting log messages and passing them along.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable information. Designed to be implemented by classes that handle logging output.
